visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-bleed campaign stage with text directly on a background image or muted looping background video
traits: background image, optionally a muted looping background video without controls
pause/play toggle for the background video
text on the media (no card), vertically centred, left-aligned by default

contentPattern.structure: 1 column. Row 1: background image (poster), optionally followed by a link to an .mp4 file that plays as a muted, looping, inline background video without controls (started only after the page has loaded; not started for users who prefer reduced motion, who keep the poster). Row 2: heading (H1 on the page stage, H2 further down), optional subtitle (the plain paragraph directly after the heading), optional text paragraph(s), optional CTA link (bold link = primary button). Option right: text aligned right (default left), always vertically centred. A pause/play toggle is shown while a background video is present; its labels default to 'Pause background video' / 'Play background video' (EN) and 'Hintergrundvideo anhalten' / 'Hintergrundvideo abspielen' (DE) and can be overridden with optional trailing rows 'Pause label | ...' and 'Play label | ...'. Defensive: the first image anywhere is the background, the first .mp4 link the video, everything else is text; rows may be merged or split.

usage: Campaign stages on /de/en/100-years (page stage with background video and H1; timeline uplift with image and H2, option right). Expected on 100-years sub-pages, stopover, offers and trade-fair pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for any full-bleed stage with text directly on the media. For a solid text card on the image use hero-card-overlay.
